_comment: Deterministic settings for the plugin safety harness. provider=mock returns built-in demo data with no network, so update() and display() render with no host dependencies. freeze_time pins the wall clock so the rotation/animation are stable. No committed golden images: the card mix animates (USPS GIF frames) and pixel-exact bitmap-font rendering drifts across freetype builds, so goldens would be flaky across CI/dev hosts; the harness still enforces crash + overflow (content past the panel edge) at every size. sizes covers the narrow/short panels (64x32, 128x32, 256x32), the wide-short rig (192x48), and the two tall panels (128x64, 256x64) to exercise the adaptive font tiers, dashboard grid, carrier badges, and marquee/truncation.
